items.name: Genesis
items.fact: The first book: creation, Abraham and Joseph.

items.fact: Moses leads Israel out of Egypt.

items.name: Leviticus
items.fact: Laws for worship and holiness.

items.name: Numbers
items.fact: Israel's counting and wandering in the wilderness.

items.name: Deuteronomy
items.fact: Moses' farewell speeches before Israel enters the land.

items.name: Joshua
items.fact: Israel enters and takes the promised land.

items.name: Judges
items.fact: A cycle of rebellion, oppression and deliverance.

items.name: Ruth
items.fact: A loyal daughter-in-law in Bethlehem.

items.name: 1 Samuel
items.fact: Samuel, Saul and the rise of David.

items.name: 2 Samuel
items.fact: David's reign in Jerusalem.

items.name: 1 Kings
items.fact: Solomon's temple and the divided kingdom.

items.name: 2 Kings
items.fact: Elijah, Elisha and the fall of Israel and Judah.

items.name: 1 Chronicles
items.fact: A history of David's family and reign.

items.name: 2 Chronicles
items.fact: The kings of Judah and the temple.

items.name: Ezra
items.fact: The return from exile and the rebuilding of the temple.

items.name: Nehemiah
items.fact: Nehemiah rebuilds the walls of Jerusalem.

items.name: Esther
items.fact: A queen in Persia saves her people.

items.name: Job
items.fact: A righteous man tested through great suffering.

items.name: Psalms
items.fact: A book of 150 songs and prayers.

items.name: Proverbs
items.fact: Wise sayings for daily life.

items.name: Ecclesiastes
items.fact: Reflections on the meaning of life.

items.name: Song of Solomon
items.fact: A love poem between a bride and bridegroom.

items.name: Isaiah
items.fact: Many prophecies about the coming Messiah.

items.name: Jeremiah
items.fact: The weeping prophet before Jerusalem falls.

items.name: Lamentations
items.fact: Laments over the fall of Jerusalem.

items.name: Ezekiel
items.fact: Visions of God's glory and the valley of dry bones.

items.name: Daniel
items.fact: Daniel in the lions' den and Shadrach, Meshach and Abed-nego.

items.name: Hosea
items.fact: A prophet's marriage pictures God's love for Israel.

items.name: Joel
items.fact: The day of the Lord and the outpouring of the Spirit.

items.name: Amos
items.fact: A shepherd from Tekoa who speaks about justice.

items.name: Obadiah
items.fact: The shortest book of the Old Testament, a message against Edom.

items.name: Jonah
items.fact: A prophet swallowed by a great fish.

items.name: Micah
items.fact: The ruler from Bethlehem and what God requires.

items.name: Nahum
items.fact: The judgement of Nineveh.

items.name: Habakkuk
items.fact: A prophet asks God why and receives an answer of faith.

items.name: Zephaniah
items.fact: The day of the Lord and the rejoicing that follows.

items.name: Haggai
items.fact: A call to rebuild the temple.

items.name: Zechariah
items.fact: Visions of restoration and the coming king.

items.name: Malachi
items.fact: The last book of the Old Testament.

items.name: Matthew
items.fact: The first Gospel, with the Sermon on the Mount.

items.name: Mark
items.fact: The shortest Gospel, full of action.

items.name: Luke
items.fact: The Gospel written by a physician.

items.name: John
items.fact: The Gospel that says 'In the beginning was the Word'.

items.name: Acts
items.fact: The early church, from Pentecost onward.

items.name: Romans
items.fact: Paul's letter on grace and faith.

items.name: 1 Corinthians
items.fact: Paul's letter to a church full of problems and gifts.

items.name: 2 Corinthians
items.fact: Paul's letter on comfort and ministry.

items.name: Galatians
items.fact: Paul's letter on freedom in Christ.

items.name: Ephesians
items.fact: Paul's letter on the church as one body.

items.name: Philippians
items.fact: Paul's letter of joy from prison.

items.name: Colossians
items.fact: Paul's letter on Christ's supremacy.

items.name: 1 Thessalonians
items.fact: Paul's encouragement to a young church about Christ's return.

items.name: 2 Thessalonians
items.fact: Paul's letter about the day of the Lord.

items.name: 1 Timothy
items.fact: Paul's instructions to a young pastor.

items.name: 2 Timothy
items.fact: Paul's last letter, urging faithfulness.

items.name: Titus
items.fact: Paul's letter on sound teaching in Crete.

items.name: Philemon
items.fact: A short letter about a runaway slave.

items.name: Hebrews
items.fact: Jesus is better than the old covenant.

items.name: James
items.fact: Faith shows itself in action.

items.name: 1 Peter
items.fact: Peter's letter of hope to suffering believers.

items.name: 2 Peter
items.fact: Peter's warning against false teachers.

items.name: 1 John
items.fact: God is light and love.

items.name: 2 John
items.fact: A short letter about walking in truth and love.

items.name: 3 John
items.fact: A short letter to Gaius about hospitality.

items.name: Jude
items.fact: A short letter warning against false teaching.

items.name: Revelation
items.fact: The last book of the Bible, a vision of the end.

items.name: Abraham
items.fact: Called from Ur to become the father of many nations.

items.name: Sarah
items.fact: Abraham's wife, mother of Isaac.

items.name: Isaac
items.fact: The son of promise born to Abraham and Sarah.

items.name: Jacob
items.fact: Isaac's son, renamed Israel.

items.name: Joseph
items.fact: Sold into Egypt and later rose to power there.

items.name: Moses
items.fact: Led Israel out of Egypt.

items.name: Aaron
items.fact: Moses' brother and the first high priest.

items.name: Joshua
items.fact: Moses' successor who led Israel into the land.

items.name: Rahab
items.fact: A woman of Jericho who hid the spies.

items.name: Gideon
items.fact: A judge who defeated Midian with three hundred men.

items.name: Samson
items.fact: A judge of great strength.

items.name: Samuel
items.fact: A prophet who anointed Israel's first kings.

items.name: Saul
items.fact: Israel's first king.

items.name: David
items.fact: The shepherd king who defeated Goliath.

items.name: Solomon
items.fact: David's son who built the temple.

items.name: Elijah
items.fact: A prophet who confronted Ahab on Mount Carmel.

items.name: Elisha
items.fact: Elijah's successor, who received a double portion.

items.name: Esther
items.fact: A queen who saved the Jews in Persia.

items.name: Job
items.fact: A righteous man who endured great suffering.

items.name: Daniel
items.fact: A young man in Babylon who was faithful to God.

items.name: Jonah
items.fact: A prophet who went to Nineveh after a great fish.

items.name: Ruth
items.fact: A loyal Moabite woman who settled in Bethlehem.

items.name: Peter
items.fact: A fisherman and leader among the twelve apostles.

items.name: Andrew
items.fact: Peter's brother, who brought him to Jesus.

items.name: James
items.fact: One of the sons of Zebedee and a leader in Jerusalem.

items.name: John
items.fact: The apostle whom Jesus loved, and writer of a Gospel.

items.name: Thomas
items.fact: The apostle called Doubting.

items.name: Matthew
items.fact: A tax collector who became an apostle.

items.name: Mary Magdalene
items.fact: A woman who was the first to see the risen Jesus.

items.name: Lydia
items.fact: A seller of purple cloth who believed in Philippi.

items.name: Stephen
items.fact: The first martyr of the church.

items.name: Barnabas
items.fact: A companion of Paul on his first journey.

items.name: Timothy
items.fact: Paul's young companion and son in the faith.

items.name: Priscilla
items.fact: A tentmaker who worked with Paul in Corinth.

items.name: Luke
items.fact: The physician and writer of a Gospel and Acts.

items.name: Paul
items.fact: Once Saul, later the apostle to the Gentiles.

items.name: Nicodemus
items.fact: A Jewish ruler who came to Jesus at night.

items.name: Zacchaeus
items.fact: A tax collector who climbed a tree to see Jesus.

items.name: Pontius Pilate
items.fact: The Roman governor who condemned Jesus.

items.name: The Flood
items.fact: God sent rain for forty days and saved Noah's family.

items.name: The Tower of Babel
items.fact: People tried to build a tower to heaven, and their language was confused.

items.name: The Exodus
items.fact: Israel left Egypt under the leadership of Moses.

items.name: The crossing of the Red Sea
items.fact: The waters divided so Israel could cross on dry land.

items.name: The golden calf
items.fact: Israel made an idol while Moses was on the mountain.

items.name: The fall of Jericho
items.fact: The walls fell after the people marched around the city.

items.name: The battle with Goliath
items.fact: A young shepherd defeated a giant with a sling.

items.name: The dedication of the temple
items.fact: Solomon's temple was finished and dedicated to God.

items.name: The exile to Babylon
items.fact: Judah was taken into captivity in Babylon.

items.name: The return from exile
items.fact: The Jews came back to Jerusalem and rebuilt the temple.

items.name: The birth of Jesus
items.fact: Jesus was born in Bethlehem.

items.name: The baptism of Jesus
items.fact: Jesus was baptised by John in the Jordan.

items.name: The temptation in the wilderness
items.fact: Jesus fasted forty days and resisted the devil.

items.name: The Sermon on the Mount
items.fact: Jesus taught the crowds about blessing and the kingdom.

items.name: The feeding of the five thousand
items.fact: Jesus fed a great crowd from five loaves and two fish.

items.name: The transfiguration
items.fact: Jesus shone with glory on a mountain with three disciples.

items.name: The crucifixion
items.fact: Jesus was put to death on a cross at Golgotha.

items.name: The resurrection
items.fact: Jesus rose from the dead on the third day.

items.name: The ascension
items.fact: Jesus was taken up into heaven.

items.name: Pentecost
items.fact: The Holy Spirit came upon the disciples in Jerusalem.

items.name: The conversion of Saul
items.fact: Saul met Jesus on the road to Damascus.

items.name: The Council of Jerusalem
items.fact: The apostles met to decide about Gentile believers.
